summary: A Ledger user received repeated calls claiming a security update was required followed weeks later by a convincing physical letter directing the recipient to scan a QR code for a purported quantum resistance update. The campaign used personal contact information and legitimate security terminology to make the phishing attempt credible.
user_mistake: engaged briefly with unsolicited callers claiming to represent Ledger
prevention: Ignore unsolicited device update instructions received by phone or mail / Initiate firmware and security updates only through the official Ledger application
